# `matchEffectToMapBoth`

Suggests Effect.mapBoth when Effect.matchEffect only transforms the failure and success channels

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377126` |
| Language Service name | `matchEffectToMapBoth` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/match-effect-to-map-both` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const program: Effect.Effect<number, string>

program.pipe(Effect.matchEffect({
/**
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(match-effect-to-map-both): `Effect.mapBoth` expresses these failure and success transformations more directly than `Effect.matchEffect`.
*/
  onFailure: (error) => Effect.fail(error.length),
  onSuccess: (value) => Effect.succeed(value + 1)
}))
```
